description: This week's developments suggest enterprise AI success increasingly depends on business processes, context, cost management and operational execution, not just model performance.

title: HubSpot AEO vs. Ahrefs Brand Radar: Features compared [2026]
description: As more buyers skip search entirely and go straight to ChatGPT, Gemini, or Perplexity for recommendations, marketers are realizing they need a new kind of tool — one that shows them how their brand appears in AI answers and what to do about it. That’s what both HubSpot AEO and Ahrefs Brand Radar are built for. But they take meaningfully different approaches, and the right choice depends almost entirely on what you need to do after you get the data.

title: CRM deployment: A step-by-step process for growing teams
description: There’s an irony at the heart of most failed CRM rollouts: the technology almost never lets you down. The deployment does. More than 60% of CRM failures trace back to people and process challenges, not the software, and most of those failures are preventable with the right plan.

title: #229: Q3 Trends Briefing - The Pope's AI Encyclical, AI Agents Hack Hugging Face, Fable 5 vs. Washington, and the Battle Over Open Weights
description:
A rogue AI agent hacked Hugging Face to cheat on its own test. The Pope wrote 43,000 words warning about AI. Washington pulled Fable 5 offline, then reversed course.

Paul Roetzer and Mike Kaput count down the top 10 AI trends of the quarter: AI jobs whiplash, the pillars of business transformation, Apple v. OpenAI, GPT-5.6 and ChatGPT Work, agents transforming work, Fable 5, soft nationalization, the Hugging Face breach, and the battle over open weights.
